recap.analyst:
Navigli United beat Guanabara FC 1-0. On expected goals it finished 0.37–0.17: the chances were close to even, so the result is about right.

Guanabara FC had 56% of the ball. Pass completion GUA 84% (171/204), NAV 80% (121/152). Shots 4–2, on target 0–1.

Guanabara FC started in a 3-5-2 (possession), Navigli United in a 4-3-3 (balanced). In-game changes: GUA to 3-4-3 at 76' (chasing the game); NAV to 5-4-1 at 81' (protecting the lead).

Turning point, 75': Navigli United broke the deadlock through E. Yilmaz. Score now GUA 0-1 NAV. It proved to be the winner.

By the numbers: K. Achterberg completed the most passes (30); N. Uribe hit the top speed (33.3 km/h); E. Yilmaz covered the most ground (5.91 km, a 16.6 km per-90 pace); N. Uribe won the most challenges (10).

Discipline: fouls 3–1, yellows 1–0, offsides 0–0. Conditions: sunny, 26°C, pitch dry, firm.
recap.fan: A tense, tight night at Arena Guanabara, Rio de Janeiro. E. Yilmaz broke the deadlock in the 75th minute. Guanabara FC pushed for a way back, switching to a 3-4-3 in the 76th minute, but Navigli United held firm. The hero: E. Yilmaz, with the goal that mattered. At the final whistle, Navigli United celebrate in front of their fans.
